This is confirmed by the docstring itself ("remove attention head 6") contradicting the task's "remove head 5". As a result the kept row/column ranges for q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, and o_proj will all be shifted by one head block relative to the required `0..639, 768..2047`, so the output will not bit-exact match the hidden reference despite passing the shape/count assertions (which only check final shapes, not which head was dropped).
